description: Verify Wave1 produced deepening artifacts per topic: evidence-summary.md, question-list.md, reference/{topic_slug}*.md rich MD reference files per topic, identity-bound Seed Topic projections through the shared readiness evaluator, and trace evidence. Source-gate status-window and handoff witness are enforced by shared gate preflight.

rules.failure_message: Wave1 completion requires a schema-valid globally quiescent queue with no active, refill, or delegated in-flight demand.
Missing directory: artifacts/wave1/. Create the directory and add per-topic evidence-summary.md files.
Missing evidence-summary file: artifacts/wave1/{topic}/evidence-summary.md. Run the deepening task for this topic via the queue-driven batch protocol.
Missing question-list file: artifacts/wave1/{topic}/question-list.md. Every topic must have a paired question-list.md alongside evidence-summary.md.
Depth-review contract failed for {topic}. Review submitted work-unit rows, exact-new source claims, cache mappings, profile checks, and repair through supplementary wave1_topic_deepening work units.
Topic {topic} has fewer than 1 reference/*{topic}*.md rich MD file. Create at least one topic-slug-prefixed reference file per shared-reference-template.md.
Reference file for {topic} contains placeholder source_url (example.com). Delete the placeholder file and write a real reference or suppl-failure-r{N}.md instead.

Reference files for {topic} must use metadata block format with eight common required fields, one resolvable UID/legacy topic binding, and five non-empty semantic sections; YAML frontmatter is not allowed.
Reference files for {topic} must declare a non-empty URL-parseable source_url in metadata block format.

Reference files for {topic} must have matching reference/_INDEX.md rows with source_layer wave1_topic. Missing index rows are reference navigation drift; source_layer is not evidence authority without submitted backing.

Reference files for {topic} must either be submitted delegated reference outputs or Phase-owned projections backed by submitted Wave1 source claims, accepted source URL surfaces, verified cache trails, explicit degraded-capture records, and scannable body backing refs.
question-list.md for {topic} must contain non-empty Topic Investigation Targets, Question Reconciliation, Emergent Question Protocol, and Exploration / Exploitation Decision sections.

evidence-summary.md for {topic} must contain at least 1 source URL in Markdown link format. The work-unit sub-agent must do real search and page fetch following the delegated access sequence in shared-page-fetch-guidance.md.
evidence-summary.md for {topic} must have a non-empty ## Key Findings section with at least 1 numbered finding.
No wave1_completion trace event found in rb_trace.jsonl. The phase must write a completion trace event before the gate.

Cache trail coverage gap detected: role=reference output files must map to verified _cache/ leaf directories. Missing or unmapped cache trails fail coverage; empty cache_trails on a declaration emits a Phase 1 warning.
No wave1 submitted work-unit ledger rows found. Claim and submit wave1_topic_deepening work units to populate rb_output_declarations.jsonl.

Wave1 delegated evidence-summary/question-list/source/cache outputs must be covered by submitted work-unit ledger rows. Topic reference files may be Phase-owned projections only when their source URLs and body refs bind back to submitted backing.
Wave1 submitted work-unit rows failed index/manifest/result/receipt/beacon/output/cache/hash cross-checks.

Wave1 delegated artifacts appear without submitted work-unit coverage or valid Phase-owned projection backing. Repair through work-unit submit, supplementary wave1_topic_deepening, or reference backing/index repair.
